name: Dan's Drive-In (Montpelier, ID) Golden Fried Halibut & Fresh Home-Cut Fries
whyItWorks: Pacific halibut is flaky, lean, and very easy on digestion. Paired with Dan's fresh-cut Idaho potatoes and tartar sauce on the side.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Halibut Basket with tartar sauce on the side; discard outer fried batter if feeling sensitive.
watchOuts: Peel off outer batter during flareups
